title: CursorPie flow file (*.cursorpie-flow.json)
description: One flow: a chain of blocks from the single Start block to the single End block. See docs/FLOWS_FOR_AI.md. The app repairs most violations on import, but a wrong shape (unknown block kind, wrong type) makes it refuse the whole file.

id.description: Unique in a config.json (Action::Flow refers to it). Replaced with a fresh id when the file is imported.

name.description: Shown in the Flow tab; trimmed, cut to 60 characters, made unique on import.

x.description: Editor position only; has no effect on what runs.

next.description: id of the block the wire from this block leads to; null or absent = no wire. End has none.

oneOf.description: Exactly one per flow. Nothing may be wired into it.
Exactly one per flow. It has no next.

OpenApp.description: App name or path, as in an Open app slice: Safari, /Applications/X.app (macOS); chrome or C:\Path\App.exe (Windows); firefox or /usr/bin/app (Linux).

OpenUrl.description: A URL or a file path, opened with the system default.

Command.description: A shell command line. Runs with the user's rights: the app warns about it when a flow with a command is imported.

Wait.description: Milliseconds. Values above 10000 are cut to 10000.

key.description: macOS virtual key code = a physical key position (not a character). Table in docs/FLOWS_FOR_AI.md.

mods.description: Bit mask: Shift 1, Ctrl 2, Alt/Option 4, Cmd 8 (the Windows key on Windows).

order.description: Optional. The order the modifiers are pressed in. Leave it out.
